ambiguity.detail: Seamus and Juliana's exact bond isn't explicitly stated, though he clearly cares about her fall from grace.

verdict.hook_line: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: This house will only bow to me.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A disgraced noblewoman works as a grassroots healer while her cruel counterparts plot to take over the estate.
verdict.why_it_works: Strong cross-cutting between a noble-turned-healer and ruthless power-hungry aristocrats creates immediate narrative tension.
